limitations: Bounded evidence for two axis settings at one retained seed, not production approval.
The selected canonical generator and Racket authority remain fixed to horizontal frames.
Inputs are deliberately constrained to be lawful under both settings; broader parametric sampling is untested.
The labelled demonstrations refute the declared alternative axis only; undeclared rivals are not exhausted.

parameter.input_dependency: two distinct interior dots, one in each horizontal half and one in each vertical half, so both axis rules are lawful on the same input
parameter.name: partition_axis

horizontal.source:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((mid (/ h 2))
                  (dots (filter (lambda (p) (!= (at g (fst p) (snd p)) 0))
                                (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                           (map (lambda (c) (cons r c)) (range 0 w)))
                                         (range 0 h))))
                  (d1 (pick-min dots fst))
                  (d2 (second (sort-by dots (lambda (p) (fst p)))))
                  (c1 (at g (fst d1) (snd d1)))
                  (c2 (at g (fst d2) (snd d2)))
                  (r1 (fst d1))
                  (r2 (fst d2)))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (if (< r mid)
                          (cond
                            ((= r r1) c1)
                            ((zero? r) c1)
                            ((or (zero? c) (= c (- w 1))) c1)
                            (else 0))
                          (cond
                            ((= r r2) c2)
                            ((= r (- h 1)) c2)
                            ((or (zero? c) (= c (- w 1))) c2)
                            (else 0))))))))

vertical.source:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((mid (/ w 2))
                  (dots (filter (lambda (p) (!= (at g (fst p) (snd p)) 0))
                                (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                           (map (lambda (c) (cons r c)) (range 0 w)))
                                         (range 0 h))))
                  (d1 (pick-min dots snd))
                  (d2 (second (sort-by dots (lambda (p) (snd p)))))
                  (c1 (at g (fst d1) (snd d1)))
                  (c2 (at g (fst d2) (snd d2)))
                  (x1 (snd d1))
                  (x2 (snd d2)))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (if (< c mid)
                          (cond
                            ((= c x1) c1)
                            ((zero? c) c1)
                            ((or (zero? r) (= r (- h 1))) c1)
                            (else 0))
                          (cond
                            ((= c x2) c2)
                            ((= c (- w 1)) c2)
                            ((or (zero? r) (= r (- h 1))) c2)
                            (else 0))))))))
